researcher_paraphrase: TSMC's CEO described CoWoS supply as very tight and said 2025 capacity was planned to more than double.
precision_guard: Current tightness is a TSMC-reported market state at the July 2024 vintage; the 2025 capacity statement is forward-looking guidance. Neither statement proves that HBM itself was the binding constraint.
